name: Aster
source:
Was wheelchair-bound as a child. Now that she's grown up, she's an energetic hero who's ready to help people in need. She's friendly and tries to be considerate (unfortunately she's dense and a little dumb/impulsive), but isn't afraid of getting into an argument with people that tick her off.

The magic Amelis core (Asteroid) in her legs have made her strong, and she can leap distances with such ease that it's almost like she's flying. She still can't do a push up, though.

However, it seems that she won't be able to keep the Amelis core forever because of certain reasons. Once it's gone, she won't be able to walk anymore just like when she was a child. So now, she's trying to make the most out of her time by going on as many adventures as possible, and helping everyone she can.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/1422692.aster]official bio[/url]]
